title: Down the mountain to Heyang
summary: Cang Song accuses Zhang Xiaofan of being a Demon Sect spy because his stick is refined with blood, and demands he be beheaded under Qingyun's rules, while Tian Buyi defends him. Dao Xuan rules that the weapon does not look like a Demon Sect weapon and tells Cang Song that Qingyun must not kill the innocent. Xiaofan placed fourth in the tournament, so Dao Xuan sends him down the mountain with the top disciples and returns the stick, saying only he can use it. Xiaofan, who has only just learned to fly, flies with Qi Hao, Lu Xueqi and Zeng Shushu to Heyang, the biggest city in the Central Plain. At the Shanhai Garden restaurant a girl named Bi Yao mocks their signature sleeping fish and says Qingyun does nothing but farm fish. That night Lu Xueqi asks Xiaofan why he gave up at the last moment of their match, and he insists he simply wasn't good enough. Later, woken by a nightmare, Xiaofan finds Bi Yao plucking a flower in the garden; they argue over whether dew is the flower's tears, and he tells her his name.
